entry_points.text: Probe claims index, zeroes record, inits port and lock, links device, fetches partner log-only, appends without irq. Removal hangs up and waits; destruction unlinks, tears down, returns index, frees and completes. Load registers vio driver; unload stops worker, frees page, unregisters tty, clears indexes. Init clamps count, allocates raw driver, registers, allocates page, starts worker.
Tty vector exposes install, open, close, write, room and throttle hooks. Interrupt suspends irq, sets scheduled read and wakes worker; unthrottle sets read and wakes; throttle only suspends irq.

Open binds port, increments count, enables irq, handshakes plus DTR except consoles. Last close discards, disables irq, drains bounded plus cancels, asks stop; hangup detaches; flush waits then cancels. Tx stages buffer, emits, schedules pushes, reports occupancy; worker requeues slow when shut else pushes and wakes. Throttle disables; unthrottle overflows, pushes, reenables; modem DTR-only.

Early init scans tree, reads tty and irq, caps count, inits ports closed, maps irq, registers console. Setup allocates raw driver, links ports, requests irqs, switches poll to sleep, unwinds on fail. Print skips unless open, expands LF to CRLF bounded discarding errors; setup validates, handshakes, raises DTR, marks console. Interrupt drains all reporting handled.

Chain created on demand under mutex, head-linked or isolated, bound to irq with auto-unlink on fail. Removal warns on missing or empty, frees irq only when last leaves, deletes node when empty, adjusts head when first departs.

exports.text: Hvsi tty ops and console plus 8250 shared irq handler and chain link helper are the outward interfaces for tty, console and irq layers.

hazards.text: Release repeats while busy requiring unbounded retries; enable failing after irq request must release line and free connection under lock.

invariants.text: Index table uses -1 free; alloc scans upward lowest free else fails, release validates and restores -1. Numeric selection fails when absent, else checks partner, clears staging, links tty and device, polls inbound and enables outside guard with unwind.

Open increments count and polls plus kicks; last close detaches, suppresses irq, waits briefly and frees line; hangup discards work and staged bytes. Output stages fixed buffer truncated, counts on stage, whole-only handoff unless retry pending, negative is I/O error; room reports free, zero when unbound.

Partner needs both ids; refresh clears then copies and frees, fails untouched without staging. Connect retries once after refresh, second invalid is busy. Vterm accepts only zero, denies when in use else tears down; current-vty denied; partner, terminal, state and index attrs show one line; rescan refreshes all.

Fixed array with count and waiter, poll then sleep. Framing needs header length, type and full length, shifts fragment. Carrier loss without local-ignore hangs up, restart re-handshakes, unknown warns. Empty skips, else capped delivery plus stash. Reception walks packets skipping errors, compacts, pushes once. Modem DTR-only.

Backup timer masks interrupts, samples ident and status, synthesizes transmit when enabled with pending bytes and empty holding register despite idle, emits, restores mask and rearms with extra delay; poll interval derives from fifo drain time.

locks.text: Per-record lock guards bitmap, connection, partner, location, index, staging and linkage. Global lock guards list outermost. Staging lock guards shared page and null check. Init mutex serializes one-time setup with unwind.

Hash mutex covers irq-info lookup, create and teardown; entry spinlock covers chain splice and handler sweep. Port lock pairs irqsave spin with nbcon acquire and release; console use needs matching registered nbcon console with atomic writer under held lock.

state_machines.text: Worker clears kicked then walks adapters; retry or quick-read remaining repeats, else sleeps until kicked, exits on stop. Per-adapter tries output, drops input when unbound, throttled or no read bit; else fetches one staging length when room allows, queues normal, quick-follows on bytes, pushes outside lock, reenables irq only when none arrived.

Phases closed, answer-wait, inquiry-wait, established, modem-wait and failed; established includes modem wait. Updates wake waiters. Answers advance via sequence to established; modem query reconstructs bits, still established on failure; unexpected only logs. Setup awaits answer, queries, blocks to open; worker retries, reports console loss; fatal errors deaden, close shuts non-console.

structs.text: Per-adapter embeds tty port and spinlock, index, bitmap, fixed staging plus count, connected flag, partner address and partition, location plus terminator, list linkage, device pointer and optional completion; from connected onward valid without tty until refs drop.

Per-port holds tty anchor, work items, waitqueues, guard, index, three byte areas with end marker, counts, ids, packet counter, modem, phase, flags with console bit and attention; version needs long alignment. Guard covers phase and buffers; walks hold it, waits outside.
Work bits 1, 2, 4 with read mask. Console major 229 minor 128, max 4 ports. Protocol v1, packet 256, inbound 16, outbound 12, accounting 12. Waits 5 ticks, delivery cap 128.
Hash entry holds linkage, irq number, chain spinlock and port head; width 5 bits, dispatch pass ceiling 512.
